0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>The bouncy Loporrit would ask you to lend them an ear.

48.original: Just the person I was hoping to see! I'd like your thoughts on something, if you have a moment.

49.original: As you might have noticed, this park is rather drab as it is now, which is why I plan to plant flowers to liven things up a little.

50.original: Of course, there's no guarantee my tastes are in line with those of your people. We have a most wondrous assortment of plants at Lovingway's Darlings, and it would mean the moon to me if you picked which flowers we use here in the park.

51.original: Hooray! To the gardens, then! You're going to love them, I know it.

52.original: Well? What do you think? In my readings I found that even a single species of flower can bloom in a number of colors, which is what makes them so appealing. Though it took a little work, these three specimens are capable of the same.

53.original: They're all charming in their own way, but I couldn't possibly decide which is best for the park.

54.original: Which do you like best? Don't worry about giving a right or wrong answer─I trust your discerning eye!

55.original: Any of these would look wonderful in the park, but which one do you like?

56.original: Oh, this one's cute! I like how the flowers are all bunched together.

57.original: Good choice! It's so sparkly and pretty!

58.original: Oooh, I like these, too! They're sure to make an impression with park visitors.

60.original: No need to rush in choosing, though I'd be lying if I said I'm not eager to hear your favorite.

61.original: A fine choice! Now, let's take a few back to the park, shall we? Do be careful not to drop any on the way!

63.original: I'm told the people of Etheirys love nature, and flowers are held in particularly high regard. I realize they're not quite the same, but I sure hope these blooms make the moon feel a little more like home.

64.original: First things first─I need to plant as many of these flowers as I can! By the time I'm done, our gardens will be a place of joy and wonderment for all, you wait and see.
